free_tier.stated: none on Workers Free: Artifacts is unavailable there. Workers Paid (USD 5 a month minimum) includes the first 10,000 operations and the first 1 GB of storage each month, then USD 0.15 per additional 1,000 operations and USD 0.50 per additional GB-month; billing for both starts on 2026-11-12
free_tier.notes: the Paid allowance is 10,000 operations and 1 GB-month of storage a month, inside a plan that costs USD 5 a month; the pricing table names no Workers Free allowance

per_object_cap.stated: 32 MiB per file, 64 MiB per push, 50,000 objects per push

retention.stated: repositories remain stored until they are explicitly deleted

egress.terms: unverified: the Artifacts pricing page lists two billed dimensions, operations and storage, and states nothing about egress

interface_detail: a Workers binding, a REST API and the Git smart-HTTP protocol over one repository; any standard Git client clones and pushes to the repository's remote URL with a short-lived repository token; Workers Builds can build and deploy a Worker from a repository
tooling: a standard Git client, the Cloudflare REST API with an API token, or the Artifacts binding in a Worker; ArtifactFS is also documented for filesystem access
chaining: source hosting for Workers Builds on the same account: a push to the production branch builds and deploys the Worker, other branches create Worker Previews. No runner of its own: it stores code and does not execute jobs. GitHub or GitLab hosting comes first for a free account

limits.value: not available on Workers Free; Workers Paid (USD 5 a month minimum) is required
1 GB per repository for repos created on or after 2026-09-29, 10 GB for earlier repos; 1 TB per account, raisable on request; repositories and namespaces unlimited
32 MiB per file; 64 MiB and 50,000 objects per push
2,000 Git requests per 10 seconds per artifact; 2,000 control-plane requests per 10 seconds per namespace

limits_note: the account ceiling of 1 TB and the per-repository ceiling apply on top of the billed 1 GB included; the per-repository ceiling was 10 GB before 2026-09-29
binding_note: the service is not available on the Workers Free plan; a Workers Paid subscription, which needs a payment method, is required before any repository can be created

identity_cost.detail: sign-up needs an email address and a password; Workers Paid needs a primary payment method (card, PayPal or a wallet) on the billing profile

reliability_note: Artifacts is in open beta (announced 2026-10-01); billing was first announced for 2026-10-14 and the pricing page now says 2026-11-12
confidence_note: every value is quoted from Cloudflare's Artifacts documentation pages read on 2026-11-02; no repository was created, the dashboard sign-up and plan upgrade were not passed, and egress terms for Artifacts are unverified

notes: Not usable on Workers Free: the docs state usage is unavailable there, so the free-account answer is no. On Workers Paid it is Git-compatible storage with 1 GB of storage and 10,000 operations included each month; its CI relevance is as a source repository for Workers Builds. Per-repository storage was 10 GB for repos created before 2026-09-29 and is 1 GB after.
